name: SBD
description: National and provincial departments and PFMA public entities. Consolidated SBD 1 + 4 + 6.1 (+3.x) spread; post-2022 SBD 4 absorbs the old SBD 8/9 declarations. State-employee bans explicit; checklist-driven evaluation. Guide ref: SA-Tender-Completion-Guide.md sections 1.2, 4, 8.

forms.kill_note: Fill EVERY field. Write the TOTAL BID PRICE on the face of the form, carried over exactly from the pricing schedule. Sign, date, state signing capacity, attach proof of authority.

Every question answered individually - a blank is a kill. List ALL directors with ID/tax numbers. Newer versions demand disclosure of ALL CSD-registered companies linked to any director, even unrelated ones. Post-2022 version absorbs the SBD 8/9 anti-collusion declarations.

Write the number of points claimed against each goal (ticks rejected at some buyers); attach the exact proof per goal - a claim without proof scores zero, and fraudulent claims carry up to 10-year blacklisting.

forms.form_name: Declaration of Local Production and Content
forms.kill_note: Designated sectors only, but pass/fail where it applies: the Declaration Certificate plus Annex C (per SATS 1286) missing by the deadline can disqualify the bid. Confirm the N/A marking otherwise.

Price every line - blanks, dashes and N/A count as unpriced and can invalidate the whole tender. Keep the printed format; firm Rand prices UNLESS the pack issues a non-firm schedule with a mandatory escalation/rate-of-exchange formula; reconcile the total to SBD1 and the Form of Offer.

Where issued: the firm/non-firm option selection is mandatory - a blank selection means the bid is not considered. Non-firm schedules carry mandatory escalation/rate-of-exchange formulas; submit the formula or be locked into fixed prices.
Where included as a returnable: complete and sign Part 1 at bid stage, in duplicate, both signed in the original, with two witnesses per party where required.
Near-cross-sector returnable, mandatory at multiple buyers - sign it wherever the pack includes one; skipping it is a missing-returnable kill.
Where included: certifies one bid per entity - more than one submission (solo or via JV) voids ALL your submissions.

name: MBD
description: Municipalities, municipal entities and TVET colleges running the MBD spread. MBD 8 and 9 are ALWAYS separate returnables; rates clearance for the company AND every director is the signature municipal gate. Mostly single-shot cure culture. Guide ref: sections 1.2, 3.2, 4, 8.

forms.kill_note: Total price on the face of the form - 'bidders who do not put prices on MBD 1 will be eliminated'. Sign with capacity stated and proof of authority attached.
Every question answered individually - a blank is a kill. All directors listed with ID and tax numbers; state-employed directors disclosed with Persal numbers.

forms.form_name: Declaration for Procurement above R10 million
forms.kill_note: Mandatory above R10m: this declaration plus THREE years of audited annual financial statements (or AFS since incorporation). Unaudited AFS cannot be fixed inside a bid window - resolve months ahead.
Points written per claimed goal, signed, exact proof attached per goal; claims must match CIPC/CSD/B-BBEE records exactly.

forms.form_name: Declaration of Local Production and Content
forms.kill_note: Designated sectors only; pass/fail where applicable (per SATS 1286).

forms.form_name: Declaration of Bidder's Past SCM Practices
forms.kill_note: Separate returnable in every municipal pack: yes/no questionnaire on restricted-supplier listing, fraud convictions, prior terminations, rates arrears. Furnish particulars for any yes; sign.
Must be signed by an authorised signatory - omission makes the bid non-responsive.
Buyer-specific; sign every declaration form the pack includes - skipping a form because it looks like legal furniture is a missing-returnable kill.
A recurring older-template trait, not a one-off: where the pack demands the MBD 2 route, the tax clearance certificate must be an ORIGINAL - certified copies are rejected.

Price every line - blanks, dashes and N/A count as unpriced and can invalidate the whole tender. Keep the printed format; reconcile the total EXACTLY to the price on the face of MBD 1 - 'bidders who do not put prices on MBD 1 will be eliminated'.
Where issued: the firm/non-firm option selection is mandatory - blank = not considered; submit the escalation formula where a non-firm schedule provides one.
Where the pack scores local-content bonus points: claim explicitly with the named proof, exactly as with MBD 6.1 - an unclaimed or unproven bonus scores zero.
Near-cross-sector returnable, mandatory at multiple buyers - sign it wherever the pack includes one.

name: SOE
description: SOEs and public entities wrap SBD content in buyer-branded forms - match forms by TITLE, not number. Portal-only submission channels; tiered curable-vs-fatal returnables with 48h-7day cure windows; buyer-specific insurance regimes. Guide ref: sections 1.2, 2, 8.

forms.kill_note: Same content and same traps as SBD 4 - identify it by title inside the buyer's own form set.
SOE point maps are often non-standard: one SOE gives B-BBEE Level 1 only 5 of 20 points, another gives Level 1 all 20. Read the buyer's actual specific-goals table.
Where the pack includes an NDA as a returnable, it is part of the bid - skipping it is a missing-returnable kill.
SANRAL Form A5, Transnet and others: 'tender may be rendered invalid' if omitted - sweep for it by title and complete it wherever the pack includes one.
IN ADDITION to SBD/MBD 9, not instead of it (Gauteng Treasury, Eskom, Transnet) - sign both where both appear.
SANRAL Form A8-style returnable; feeds the buyer's PPPFA s2(1)(f) objective-criteria review - disclose fully, understatement risks the whole bid.
An unticked lot = disqualified for that lot - tick every lot/field you intend to bid.

name: CIDB
description: Construction overlay on top of the funding buyer's regime: CIDB C1.1 Form of Offer, T/A-series returnable schedules, NEC/GCC contract forms, CIDB grading as an absolute eligibility gate, signed (and where demanded notarised) JV agreement BEFORE submission, bid-stage H&S and quality plans, performance guarantee post-award. Guide ref: sections 1.3, 3.2, 4.6, 8.

forms.kill_note: Sign the Offer with the total price in words AND figures, witnessed. Failure to sign, or to carry the price over from the pricing/activity schedule, renders the tender invalid.
Every schedule in the pack's returnables list must be present, completed and signed; locate the pack's filing clause (F.2.13.x) - a pack-level filing rule overrides per-form attachment instructions.

forms.form_name: Priced Schedule / Bill of Quantities (C2.2 pricing worksheet)
forms.kill_note: Price every item of the pricing data / BoQ including rate-only items - 'items against which N/A, left blank or - (dash) is entered' invalidate the tender at about half of buyers; carry the total over to the C1.1 Form of Offer in words AND figures - a missing or mismatched carry-over renders the tender invalid.
Per the pack's H&S Specification - include it even if the pack's own checklist omits it.
Include where scored or demanded (with ISO certification where it scores).
An independent kill where present: failure to tick the ACCEPT ALL box on the contract conditions = disqualification - check for it as its own returnable, not part of the contract form.

name: RFQ
description: Minimal form spread - sometimes only SBD 4 + 6.1 - but the core kill-rules still apply in full: late = dead, unpriced lines, unsigned forms, defaulters listing. Judge RFQ-vs-formal-bid by content, not the cover page: SOE 'RFQs' can carry full scored functionality gates, and the label warning is not construction-specific. Short validity (30-90 days). RFQs often default to VAT-EXCLUSIVE if silent. Cure culture follows the issuing buyer's regime - SOE RFQs can carry tiered cure windows; assume single-shot only for small municipal/departmental RFQs. RFI (market sounding - register interest or you won't receive addenda) and EOI (non-binding market test up to a full three-phase scored pipeline) are separate pack types - judge by content. Guide ref: sections 1.1, 8.

forms.kill_note: Same traps as the formal-bid SBD 4: every question answered individually, all directors disclosed.
Same 80/20 rules as formal bids; points written per goal with proof attached.
